item.title: maybe personal websites should be messy
item.description:
i’ve been looking at too many perfectly designed websites lately. everything is the same: a hero section, a grid of cards, a “built with love” footer. somewhere between the gradients and the glassmorphism, all the personality got squeezed out.

maybe we should go back to the days of weird marquees and under construction gifs. okay, maybe not that far.

item.title: an ai just built my unity game
item.description:
i hooked up a local llm directly into unity editor via a custom endpoint. told it to “make a character that can walk around and jump.” it generated the c# script, attached it, and added a rigid body. i am terrified.

item.title: figuring shit out at eighteen
item.description: i don’t think there’s a version of being eighteen where you have it together. and i’m slowly making peace with that. this is the part where you’re supposed to be figuring things out, not having them figured out.

item.title: tiny things i've built lately
item.description: not everything needs to be a startup. sometimes you just build a small thing that scratches your own itch, put it somewhere on the internet, and that’s enough.

item.title: in defense of being bored
item.description: i’ve been thinking about boredom a lot lately. not the crushing kind, but the quiet kind — the kind that happens when you put your phone down and just sit there with nothing to do.

item.title: elden ring still lives rent-free in my head
item.description: two years later and i’m still thinking about the ending.
